source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.4, block for block (PDF 92).

blocks.text: Blood group system khoon ki darja bandi (classification) ka tareeqa hai, jo red blood cells (RBCs) par khaas antigens ki maujoodgi par mabni hai. International Society of Blood Transfusion insanon mein 43 blood group systems ko tasleem karti hai (kitab ke mutabiq). Har system ke apne blood groups hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Blood group systems mein RBCs ki satah (surface) par maujood antigens proteins, carbohydrates, glycoproteins ya glycolipids ho sakte hain.

Sab se ahem ABO system hai (blood groups A, B, AB, O), aur doosra Rh system hai (blood groups Rh-positive aur Rh-negative). Khoon dene (blood transfusion) ke liye donor (dene wale) aur recipient (lene wale) ke khoon ka ABO aur Rh system mein milna zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Blood transfusion se pehle kaun se do blood group systems milane zaroori hain?

items: Blood groups RBCs ki satah ke antigens se tay hote hain.
ABO sab se ahem aur Rh doosra system hai; transfusion mein dono milane zaroori hain.
